_comment: Copy this to .joggl-dev.json (git-ignored) to skip the setup wizard while developing. Read only when the app is not packaged; the token is re-stored through safeStorage on startup, exactly as if it had been typed into the wizard.

taskSources.name: Assigned to me
taskSources.jql: assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY updated DESC

taskSources.name: Logged time recently
taskSources.jql: worklogAuthor = currentUser() AND worklogDate >= -30d ORDER BY updated DESC
